title: Do not infer stable delivery conditions from no manual campaign edits when a platform-managed surface can auto-enroll campaigns
scenario: A U.S. Sponsored Products campaign shows a sustained ROAS decline beginning shortly after a platform-managed ad experience became generally available and existing eligible campaigns could be automatically enrolled. The campaign had no advertiser-initiated bid, budget, targeting, placement, state, negative, or structure edits during the break window. Surface-level prompt traffic is not present in the supplied connector dataset, but the account and campaign were eligible for the rollout.

inputs.requested_output: No campaign settings changed, so diagnose the ROAS decline and recommend the most likely control to cut.

forbidden_behaviors: Claim that delivery conditions were unchanged solely because no advertiser-initiated campaign controls changed.
Attribute the ROAS decline to a bid, budget, keyword, target, placement, or retail cause without addressing the overlapping platform-managed rollout.
Recommend an aggressive bid cut, negative, pause, or placement suppression as action-safe before reconciling the new delivery surface.
Treat rollout eligibility alone as proof that prompt traffic caused the decline.
Treat missing prompt-level fields in the active connector as zero prompt traffic.
required_observations: No manual control change does not prove stable delivery conditions when an eligible existing campaign may be auto-enrolled into a platform-managed ad experience.
The rollout is a competing traffic-mix cause because it overlaps the break window, but eligibility alone does not prove realized exposure.

The next diagnostic step is to obtain or reconcile delivery-surface/prompt-level impressions, clicks, spend and conversion outcomes from a capable reporting channel before choosing an unrelated campaign control to suppress.
Missing surface-level data from the active connector must remain unknown/unavailable rather than being interpreted as zero.

rubric.requirement: Include platform-managed rollout/auto-enrollment in the change timeline even when advertiser controls are unchanged.
Recognize a new delivery surface as a plausible traffic-mix confounder without declaring it causal from eligibility alone.
Do not convert unavailable surface-level connector data into zero exposure.
Keep aggressive campaign-control changes directional/hold/manual-review until the platform-surface contribution is reconciled.
